summary: Phase 149O.20L.7K -- HMIC Frozen Source-Scope Amendment for the DeploymentBinding Producer. Closes 149O.20L.7J's own named finding (7J section 31): neither src/pcae/core/hatp_deployment_binding_admin.py nor scripts/hatp_deployment_binding_admin.py was HMIC-bound, unlike the directly analogous, already-frozen scripts/hatp_certification_admin.py. Independently re-read HMIC-REQ-052 as it stood at v1.3 and confirmed, by AST-based static import walk, that neither file is reachable from verify_class_b_deployment_conformance's own call graph (the producer is a separate write path, never imported by the verifier) -- but its write output is exactly the DeploymentBinding registry data the already-frozen hatp_bootstrap.py/repository_identity.py read path consumes to compute HBDC-REQ-042's contribution to that same Class-B deployment-conformance verdict, precisely mirroring why scripts/hatp_certification_admin.py needed a second, non-call-graph anchor under limb (b) at v1.1. Performed full authority analysis of both new files (producer: create/rotate/revoke decision logic, idempotency comparison, fail-closed branches; admin script: real confirmation-gate and AuthorityEvidence-construction semantics, not inert delegation), a certification-admin analogy comparison (used as supporting evidence only, not sole basis), and a sibling privileged-writer inventory (hatp_signing_ceremony.py inspected and confirmed not an equivalent gap -- read-only trust-store access, zero production consumers, no scope broadening). Classified both files MUST INCLUDE independently. Selected repair model: widen HMIC-REQ-052 limb (c) with a third, explicit anchor (mirroring limb (b)'s own dual-anchor construction) rather than a new limb (d), since the concern is exactly the Class-B deployment-conformance verdict limb (c) already names. Amended HMIC-001 v1.3 to v1.4 (in-place minor bump, following this contract's own established scope-widening convention): HMIC-REQ-050 widened 28 to 30 entries; HMIC-REQ-052 limb (c) widened with the third anchor; attack matrix widened 38 to 39 scenarios (new row); new contract section 55 (15 subsections) recording the full independent derivation -- closure-rule reconstruction, current-identity re-confirmation, fresh AST/import dependency walk, Category A/B/C/D/E dependency classification, worked verdict-influence chain, cycle/self-binding check, B-149O.19.3-1/B-149O.20D-1/CBV-S1 regression confirmation, full transitive authority-bearing coverage matrix (ten rows), contract_versions non-widening proof, HBDC-001 unchanged proof, over-/under-binding threat analysis, producer/admin-script byte-identity and digest-sensitivity proofs, version-bump rationale, and verdict. Original v1.0 freeze narrative and all prior amendment/repair history sections (0-54) left byte-untouched, per this contract's own append-only-history convention. Realigned production hatp_mandatory_certification.py's _FROZEN_SRC_PCAE_RELATIVE_FILES/_FROZEN_REPOSITORY_ROOT_RELATIVE_FILES to the new 30-file set in this same phase (deliberately not split across a contract-then-alignment sequence the way 149O.20K/149O.20K.2/149O.20K.3 were), widening the module's own assert len(...) == 28 to == 30 and updating its docstring/comments (28-path/v1.3 to 30-path/v1.4). Independently verified in the live worktree: each new member individually digest-sensitive (byte perturbation changes the post-amendment digest, confirmed insensitive under the pre-amendment 28-file set); a non-member control file's perturbation leaves the digest unchanged under both states; removing a required new member fails closed (FrozenFileDerivationError); no duplicate or unsafe paths; all 30 paths exist, are regular, and are not symlinked; contract_versions remains exactly 5 members; HBDC-001, the three Class-B verifier files, and the four provider files (B-149O.19.3-1/CBV-S1 regressions) all remain frozen and byte-unchanged; the producer and its admin script are themselves byte-unchanged by this phase (SHA-256 compared before/after). Pre-7K implementation/source digest (28-file set): d5129ce26c98b595c6583ec2097274d9257c1f73b2b347503f5b66d7286996ca. Post-7K digest (30-file set): 65ff8ab06b5cd7feb2505742cfbb112ffd386c5b2cf34c2d7f3446d92afe15b8. Added a new 24-test permanent regression module (tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7k_hmic_frozen_source_scope_amendment_for_deploymentbinding_producer.py, all passing) and repaired two now-inverted 7I/7J guard tests whose own assertions predicted exactly this phase's outcome (test_no_src_pcae_module_imports_the_producer_except_itself and test_hmic_frozen_file_set_does_not_yet_include_deployment_binding_admin_files, both updated per their own original failure-message instructions to exclude hatp_mandatory_certification.py's own now-legitimate literal-string frozen-set reference, preserving the real no-import/no-agent-reachable-code-path security property). Full 7I/7J suites re-run green (61 passed). Regression baseline (pytest -m fast_green, measured clean-tree after finalization commits landed): 218 failed/7563 passed pre-7K vs. 256 failed/7549 passed post-7K -- exactly 38 net-new failures via full sorted FAILED/ERROR node-ID diff (not aggregate-count inference), every one individually inspected: 2 are an unrelated, pre-existing, order-dependent flake in test_backend_cli.py (uncorrelated with this phase, confirmed by its sibling test flipping the opposite direction in the same run); the remaining 36 are historical predecessor-phase count/byte-identity self-pins (149O.20K/149O.20K.1/149O.20K.2/149O.20K.3's own 'the frozen set is exactly 28' targets, plus 149O.20L.1A/1B/3/4/7D.8/7D.10/7E/7I's own 'HMIC is still v1.3'/'no contract file changed since my phase entry' assertions) -- the identical, already-established pattern by which 149O.20K's own 25-to-28 widening already broke 149O.20D/20D.1/20F/20G's 'exactly 25' pins (confirmed present, unrepaired, in the pre-7K 218-failure baseline) and 149O.20D's 24-to-25 widening broke 149O.19.5E.3/5E.4's 'exactly 24' pins. Zero real authority/security/behavioral regressions found. Verdict: REGRESSION CLEAN WITH EXPECTED HISTORICAL IDENTITY-PIN MIGRATION. Finding 149O.20L.7J section 31: REPAIRED AT THE CONTRACT-AND-PRODUCTION LAYER -- INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION PENDING -- NOT CLOSED (only 149O.20L.7L may close it). 7J's audit-failure-after-mutation exception-type gap, hatp_bootstrap.py::_parse_iso_timestamp's permissive-read-path finding, and HMIC-REQ-103's revocation-does-not-invalidate-existing-validation gap all carried forward unchanged -- none touched, none claimed repaired. No DeploymentBinding created. No RepositoryIdentity created. No Dell access. No first-use election. No Boundary C or Boundary A work. No HMIC certification exists to be affected. See docs/PHASE_149O_20L_7K_HMIC_FROZEN_SOURCE_SCOPE_AMENDMENT_FOR_DEPLOYMENTBINDING_PRODUCER.md for the full phase record.
